import re, glob, os, json, collections
D = "/tmp/r2run-hrs_de_d/data/text"
out = []
for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(D, "*.txt"))):
    txt = open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    pages = re.split(r"=== page (\d+)", txt)
    # pages list: [pre, num, body, num, body...]
    for i in range(1, len(pages), 2):
        pno, p = pages[i], pages[i+1]
        if not re.search(r"Case\s*Number", p): continue
        resp = re.search(r"Respondent:(.*)", p)
        m = re.search(r"violation\s*\(\s*s\s*\)\s*:(.*?)recommends\s+the\s+following", p, re.S)
        cite_block = " ".join(m.group(1).split()) if m else ""
        cm = re.search(r"IC\s*8\s*-?\s*\S*\s*-?\s*26\S*\s*\S*", cite_block)
        cite = re.sub(r"\s+", "", cm.group(0)) if cm else ""
        rm = re.search(r"recommends\s+the\s+following\s+civil\s+penalty\s*:(.*?)(Abstentions|APPROVED|Additional Information|$)", p, re.S)
        rec = " ".join(rm.group(1).split()) if rm else ""
        out.append(dict(file=os.path.basename(f), page=int(pno), resp=(resp.group(1).strip() if resp else ""),
                        cite_block=cite_block, cite=cite, rec=rec))
json.dump(out, open(os.environ["TMPDIR"]+"/an/cases2.json","w"), indent=1)
print("pages with Case Number:", len(out))
print("no cite:", sum(1 for x in out if not x["cite"]))
print("no resp:", sum(1 for x in out if not x["resp"]))
print("no rec match:", sum(1 for x in out if not x["rec"]))

        resp = re.search(r"Respondent:(.*)", p)
        cb = re.search(r"violation\s*\(\s*s\s*\)\s*:(.*?)recommends\s+the\s+following", p, re.S)
        cblock = " ".join(cb.group(1).split()) if cb else ""
        cm = re.search(r"IC\s*8\s*[-–]?\s*\S+", cblock)
        cite = re.sub(r"\s+", "", cm.group(0)) if cm else ""
        rm = re.search(r"recommends\s+the\s+following\s+(?:civil\s+)?penalty\s*:(.*?)(?=Abstentions|APPROVED|Additional Information|$)", p, re.S)

        q = None
        qm = re.search(r"\((expire|prior|out)\)$", cite)
